import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    budget = int(next(it))
    tab = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    
    even = 0
    odd = 0
    for x in tab:
        if x % 2 == 0:
            even += 1
        else:
            odd += 1
    
    if even != odd:
        print(0)
        return
    
    cuts = []
    even = 0
    odd = 0
    for i in range(n - 1):
        if tab[i] % 2 == 0:
            even += 1
        else:
            odd += 1
        if even == odd:
            cuts.append(abs(tab[i + 1] - tab[i]))
    
    cuts.sort()
    used = 0
    count = 0
    for cost in cuts:
        if used + cost <= budget:
            used += cost
            count += 1
        else:
            break
    print(count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
